_experiment: observed-graph detectors on the full headline design

design.paired_control: matched seeds; seed depends on (c, arm, replicate) only
design.censoring: each non-firing detector is assigned n_cycles=320
design.uncertainty: 2,000 deterministic run-resampling bootstrap draws; standard error is the bootstrap standard deviation and interval is the percentile 95% interval

obs_giant_frac._declared: CALIBRATED 2026-09-03 on 600 dedicated control runs, seed block 960000-960599, disjoint from earlier calibration blocks and every scored seed below 900000. Configuration c=1.0, white/mid, MNAR, identical to the existing recalibration. The observable is obs_giant_frac. All other leading-rule fields are copied unchanged from detection_rule_recal.json. Selection is the same declared procedure: the smallest k on the 2.00 to 16.00 quarter-step grid with calibration-null FPR at or below 3.5%. The rule is applied unchanged at every coverage, error colour, severity, consent arm, and scenario.

leading.class_mixing: mean of per-class standardised statistic (variance-family only; no covariance across node pairs)
leading.standardisation: z against the same run's baseline period [window-1, 90)

lagging.metric: program-close output, trailing mean over 10 cycles

obs_mean_degree._declared: CALIBRATED 2026-09-03 on 600 dedicated control runs, seed block 960000-960599, disjoint from earlier calibration blocks and every scored seed below 900000. Configuration c=1.0, white/mid, MNAR, identical to the existing recalibration. The observable is obs_mean_degree. All other leading-rule fields are copied unchanged from detection_rule_recal.json. Selection is the same declared procedure: the smallest k on the 2.00 to 16.00 quarter-step grid with calibration-null FPR at or below 3.5%. The rule is applied unchanged at every coverage, error colour, severity, consent arm, and scenario.

leading.class_mixing: mean of per-class standardised statistic (variance-family only; no covariance across node pairs)
leading.standardisation: z against the same run's baseline period [window-1, 90)

lagging.metric: program-close output, trailing mean over 10 cycles

latency._declared: RECALIBRATED 2026-08-05 on a dedicated null of 600 control runs, seed block 950000+ (fresh, disjoint from campaign 1's calibration block 900000-900039 and from every scored seed, all of which are < 900000). Configuration c=1.0, white/mid, MNAR -- identical to campaign 1's calibration configuration; only the sample size and the FPR target changed. Rule FORM is unchanged from configs/detection_rule.json: only the leading threshold k and the lagging threshold k_sd were re-picked. Selection, declared in advance: leading = smallest k with calibration null FPR <= 3.5%; lagging = among rules with calibration null FPR <= 3.5% and calibration detection rate >= 0.5, the earliest-detecting. Applied UNCHANGED at every coverage level, noise colour, severity and consent arm. See spec section 9 amendment large-null recalibration.

leading.class_mixing: mean of per-class standardised statistic (variance-family only; no covariance across node pairs)
leading.standardisation: z against the same run's baseline period [window-1, 90)

lagging.metric: program-close output, trailing mean over 10 cycles
